verdict.rationale: Evidence shows x402 is described as an 'open standard' now governed by the vendor-neutral, Linux-Foundation-hosted x402 Foundation after Coinbase 'completed its contribution of the protocol,' which implies publicly available source, but no citation identifies an actual repository, license file, or SPDX license (e.g., MIT/Apache). Missing for 10: a direct link to source code, an explicit open-source license grant, and independent confirmation that the codebase (not just the protocol concept) is publicly readable.
